title: L9 Intelligence consumer view of l9.finding-bundle/v1
description: Intelligence-owned compatibility subset of the SDK's public finding-bundle contract. Quantum-L9/l9-ci-sdk remains the sole authority for l9.finding-bundle/v1; this document declares only what Intelligence requires in order to redact a bundle and project it onto l9.corpus-event/v1. It is deliberately not a copy of the producer's authoritative schema: unknown properties are permitted at every level so an additive, backwards-compatible producer extension does not break ingestion, and constraints are asserted only where a value is read, redacted, or carried into lineage. In particular `snapshot.revision` is required because a bundle with no exact revision cannot be bound to a subject, and every `normalized_path` is required to be a string because the adapter must be able to replace it.
